rapport_notes: Clear and organized walking through an unusual 2-day pack/floor-replacement/move-back scenario, set expectations well (e.g., 'we do not unpack it').

evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: "you will only be charged for how much time we use during the move" / "you will only be charged for how much materials we use when we do the packing"

top_strength: Broke down a genuinely unusual 2-day (pack-move / move-back) job into two clear estimates and a combined total without confusing the customer.
coaching_note: No explicit ask to book -- customer asked for the quote by email and the rep just agreed to send it, without a follow-up close attempt.
